what_it_does: Compares agentic artificial intelligence (large language models acting as autonomous agents) against traditional machine learning autotuning for optimizing high-performance computing code. The problem is loop reordering—rearranging nested loops to improve cache locality and memory bandwidth in HPC kernels. The study tests GPT-4.1, Claude 4.0, and Gemini 2.5 as agents using specialized prompt patterns (Persona and Context Manager) and measures how many iterations each method needs and whether the optimization choices are correct.
